title: Shopping starts with AI, and our store must be ready for it
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gifts (Gartner). HP launched an agentic web platform; TikTok and Gap added AI shopping. Prime Big Deal Days drove $9.86B online (Adobe).

points.headline: AI is now where shoppers begin, so our content must be readable by it
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Gartner: 34% would use GenAI for gifts. Anti-bot defenses block shopping agents (TechCrunch). Check our product data and agent access.

points.headline: Competitors and platforms are rebuilding storefronts around AI agents
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI, a web platform adapting to intent; TikTok added an AI shopping agent with one-click checkout; Gap added natural-language search. Benchmark our discovery.

points.headline: Memory costs squeeze AI PC pricing while premium tiers arrive
points.detail: Suppliers favour server DRAM (DigiTimes); memory costs threaten shipments; Microsoft prices Surface Laptop Ultra at $2,599. Plan pricing and stock messaging on our store.

points.headline: Holiday demand is strong but selective, and Amazon sets the pace
points.detail: Prime Big Deal Days hit $9.86B (Adobe); Adobe forecasts $275.1B holiday online sales; Amazon India sees a 35-40% festive spike. Prepare promotions and stock on marketplaces.
